results.title: Nakshatra
results.label: Nakshatra #{index} / 27
results.note: For accurate Nakshatra, Moon position (kundli calculation) is required.

nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.nature: Fast, energetic, healing nature. Quick decision maker with a bold spirit.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.nature: Strong will, intense emotions, and transformation energy. Deep responsibility vibes.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.nature: Sharp, fearless, and goal-focused. Natural leader with a powerful presence.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.nature: Charming, creative, and comfort-loving. Strong attraction and emotional warmth.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.nature: Curious, playful, and always searching for meaning. Intelligent and adaptable.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.nature: Intense thinker with strong emotions. Powerful growth after challenges.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.nature: Optimistic, pure-hearted, and calm. Brings stability and fresh starts.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.nature: Supportive, disciplined, and nurturing. Strong spiritual and family values.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.nature: Mystical, strategic, and emotionally deep. Highly intuitive and protective.

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.nature: Royal mindset, proud, and traditional. Strong respect for ancestors and legacy.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.nature: Romantic, fun-loving, and artistic. Loves luxury, creativity, and comfort.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.nature: Reliable, loyal, and partnership-focused. Strong responsibility and leadership.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.nature: Skillful, clever, and practical. Great communication and hardworking energy.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.nature: Creative, stylish, and ambitious. Strong desire to build something unique.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.nature: Independent, flexible, and freedom-loving. Balanced mindset and diplomatic nature.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.nature: Goal-driven, determined, and competitive. Strong focus on success and growth.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.nature: Loyal, friendly, and spiritually aligned. Strong bonding and supportive nature.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.nature: Protective, powerful, and mature. Strong leadership with deep emotions.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.nature: Truth seeker, intense, and transformational. Removes negativity and rebuilds stronger.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.nature: Confident, persuasive, and proud. Strong belief system and unstoppable energy.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.nature: Disciplined, responsible, and victory-minded. Strong ethics and leadership.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.nature: Wise listener, calm, and learning-focused. Strong spiritual intelligence.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.nature: Ambitious, energetic, and socially active. Strong rhythm, music, and success vibes.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.nature: Mysterious, healing, and independent. Deep thinker with strong intuition.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.nature: Intense, visionary, and spiritual. Powerful transformation and inner strength.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.nature: Calm, wise, and stable. Strong patience, maturity, and spiritual depth.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.nature: Gentle, caring, and protective. Brings emotional peace and guidance energy.
